headline: Fountain Of Life Church Postpones Service Amid Succession Dispute
seoTitle: Fountain Of Life Church Leadership Dispute Update
metaDescription: Fountain of Life Church has postponed its annual thanksgiving service as the leadership crisis involving Jimmy Odukoya and the board of trustees continues.
aiSummaryBullets: The Fountain of Life Church has delayed its 2026 thanksgiving service indefinitely amid an ongoing leadership conflict.
The dispute involves the church's board of trustees and Pastor Jimmy Odukoya, who currently retains his position despite board opposition.
Trustees have appointed an interim leader and released a video they claim outlines the founder's succession plan, while Odukoya maintains his tenure.
aiContextParagraph: The Fountain of Life Church is currently experiencing an internal leadership dispute involving Pastor Jimmy Odukoya and the organization's board of trustees. The board has publicly stated that they have removed Odukoya from his position as senior pastor, citing concerns related to succession. In response, Odukoya has rejected this decision, asserting his right to remain in the role. The situation has intensified following the release of a video by the trustees that purportedly documents the founder's wishes regarding leadership succession. Three key pastors are central to the current tension, each occupying different positions within the succession narrative or the church hierarchy. Amid these conflicting claims and the ongoing administrative disagreement, the church announced the postponement of its planned 2026 thanksgiving service, with no rescheduled date provided at this time.
whyItIsViral: The story is being tracked by two independent media outlets and has generated significant recent coverage regarding the administrative conflict within the religious organization.
